description: Nested ranked blocks retain their common outside identity (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $x:outer %conditions $x.without-elision.matches(same), ¬($x.without-elision.matches(flat))

%rule outer (left ≻ right)
%rule left inner
%rule right (X [+V])
%rule inner (a ≻ b)
%rule a (X [+T])
%rule b (X [+U])
%rule same outer
%rule flat (X [+T])
